1981-2415-3967-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-6097.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3967-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3967-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7753-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1479-3604-5621.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Cadric (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

582-2034-3055-3953.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brazen Freebooter, adding {C}{C}.
When Brazen Freebooter dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Brazen Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Brazen Freebooter.
Repeat.

647-2203-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
647-2203-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-3784-5517.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat

821-1385-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

56-5256-6112-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-5256-6112-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Fumulus and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-5256-6112-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

339-677-1879-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1365-1651-5315-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-5315-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

2292-2843-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2292-2843-6553.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature except Mirror-Mad Phantasm with Mirror-Mad Phantasm chosen

2084-4301.description: Activate the creature with Metamorphic Alteration attached using Mirror-Mad Phantasm's ability by paying {1}{U}, causing you to shuffle the creature into your library and mill all cards from your library.

465-1879-3742-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1879-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1621-2440-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
The token copy of Wispweaver Angel enters, triggering itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

891-2386-2921-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-2921-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1409-2208-2499.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-2208-2499.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve both Charming Scoundrel triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1378-3057.notablePrerequisites:
Mirage Phalanx is paired with Bloodthirster.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1378-3057.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Bloodthirster each trigger, creating a token copy of Mirage Phalanx and Bloodthirster with haste.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Bloodthirster tokens each trigger, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

57-232-2178-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-232-2178-5256.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Urabrask' power.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1486-2719-3337-4875.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reflection of Kiki-Jiki's ability, creating a token copy of other Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2981-3858-4099.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
2981-3858-4099.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing an artifact, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 three additional times.
Activate Atogatog by sacrificing Megatog, giving Atogatog +15/+15 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.

618-4031-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You have a full party.
618-4031-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Electromancer.
The Ardent Electromancer token enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2440-2744-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2440-2744-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1703-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
Fool's Demise attached to Coretapper.
1703-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it.
Fool's Demise goes to the graveyard from the battlefield as a state-based action.
Both of Fool's Demises triggered abilities trigger.
Resolve Fool's Demise's first triggered ability, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Fool's Demise second triggered ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Coretapper's ability from step 2, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, targeting Coretapper.
Repeat each turn.

350-2440-4963.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card, an additional creature in hand to cast, or an additional {4}{W}{U}.
350-2440-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
Cast Beck, fusing it if you have the mana available, otherwise using some other way to draw a card.
Instead of drawing a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Mana Echoes and Beck trigger.
Allow Mana Echoes to resolve first, adding {C} for each bear you control.
Before Beck's trigger resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite bears and colorless mana.

3921-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
3921-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.

593-2615-4752.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Mogg Maniac has selected the opponent that will be targeted with Tree of Perdition.
593-2615-4752.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Into the Maw of Hell for {4}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing thirteen damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
